name: com.badranraza.ide.antigravity
description: Antigravity IDE integration for Unity. Adds Google Antigravity IDE (the VS Code-based code editor in the Antigravity product line) as an External Script Editor option, auto-selects it when discovered, generates .csproj/.sln for IntelliSense, and offers single-instance window reuse. Detects Antigravity IDE specifically and ignores the standalone Antigravity 2.0 agent app.

_upm.changelog: Added automatic External Script Editor selection for Antigravity IDE after package import, plus recommended project generation defaults for embedded, local, registry, Git, local tarball and unknown packages.
